q2_zoningUnmeasured.reachesOtherCounties: Yes, structurally confirmed, not assumed. Within the parcel_record-instantiated population, the cityLimits rail resolves 100% cleanly in ALL SIX counties (0 refused/unaccounted anywhere). The entire exposure is the parcel_record INSTANTIATION GAP itself (CTX-F's known figures, re-confirmed live): nonzero in five of six counties (48021 ~15.5K, 48055 ~23.7K, 48209 ~56.6K, 48309 ~1, 48453 ~119.4K, 48491 ~319.5K parcels with no parcel_record row at all). The 2026-09-01 CAD-SERVE-RECONCILE sweep already caught live zoning.verdict=unmeasured in 48209/48453/48491; the absence of a hit in 48021/48055 in that 146-parcel non-random sweep is a sampling gap, not evidence of exemption -- both counties carry a real, nonzero instantiation gap of their own.
q2_zoningUnmeasured.isTheWalkCorrectToRefuseIt: Yes. Before this morning's classifyRequiredLeaf change (P-124 CTX-LEAVES, 2026-09-08), any served object with an unrecognised verdict token graded as {state:'value', ok:true} unconditionally -- so verdict:'unmeasured' on the zoning leaf would have silently certified an unresolved lookup as a populated value. The classifier refusing it now is the fix working correctly, exposing a producer nobody had graded content against before (Williamson's own bake had never been content-graded prior to this walk). This is exactly the good-outcome-badly-disguised case the dispatch asked to establish rather than assume.
q2_zoningUnmeasured.notARelaxationNeeded: _decisions/2026-09-01_serve_path_never_emits_pipeline_state.md already rules this exact class of leak must convert at serve to absent-verified-with-basis or refused, and explicitly forbids adding unmeasured as a permitted fifth state. That ruling was never implemented against verdictLayerServe.ts's zoning path (still a live, tested, 5-state LAYER_ABSENCE_VERDICTS enum on origin/main). absent-verified is the wrong target (it asserts a positive, confirmed absence the program's own vocabulary reserves for a real determination; here nothing was determined either way) -- refused is the correct conversion, per the decision's own second option.
q2_zoningUnmeasured.thirdFailingLeaf: provenance.zoningSource also fails with verdict='unmeasured' on the same cohort, confirmed via direct classification. This is not a fourth independent defect: it mirrors zoning's verdict verbatim by design (CTX-MIRROR, legacy-design-tools PR #646) and will resolve the moment the zoning leaf's conversion is fixed at the same serve boundary.
